description: VAREX HUD 50080-TIHD payment voucher contract with header parties, a voucher total, signatory data, and repeated requested amounts.
instructions: Extract only values explicitly stated in the HUD 50080-TIHD payment voucher. Do not infer, calculate, reconcile, or populate a missing value. Extract every populated requested-amount row as a separate line item in document order. Preserve identifiers, dates, names, and amounts exactly as stated, excluding currency symbols from numeric values. Return null when the source does not state a scalar value and an empty array when it states no line items.

period_covered.description: Date range covered by the voucher exactly as stated.

disbursement_type.description: Disbursement type, where 1 is partial and 2 is final.

voucher_total.description: Total amount of the voucher without a currency symbol.

authorized_signatory.description: Name and title of the authorized signatory.

date_of_request.description: Date when the voucher request was made.

tin.description: Tax identification number of the grantee.
Tax identification number of the payee.

line_items.description: Every populated requested-amount row in document order.

amount.description: Amount requested on the row without a currency symbol.

document_rules.description: Check that voucher identity, parties, total, line amounts, signatory, and request date are present.
Require the disbursement type to be 1 or 2.
Require the voucher total and each requested amount to be non-negative.
Check that all requested amounts add to the stated voucher total.
